Based on my analysis of the issue, the error `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed'` occurs because the `rank_zero_only` function was moved/removed from `pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed` in newer versions of pytorch_lightning. The following files in the project directly import from this now-missing module and need to be fixed to use a compatible import (e.g., falling back to `pytorch_lightning.utilities.rank_zero`):

1. **`modules/models/diffusion/ddpm_edit.py`** - line 22 imports `from pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed import rank_zero_only`
2. **`extensions-builtin/LDSR/sd_hijack_ddpm_v1.py`** - line 17 imports `from pytorch_lightning.utilities.distributed import rank_zero_only`
